encoding_and_prefill.notes: Mode 0 resolves placeholders to plain English text on prompt encode.
Mode 1 preserves BP/SE codes during prompt encode and decodes them in postProcess.
Mode 2 base64-encodes system/user prompts and decodes model responses.
Mode 3 applies Atbash alphabet inversion to prompts and responses.

Unclosed assistant tag captures remaining string as char prefill.

schema_conditionals.notes: Full Mode 0 schema includes sex, position, supplement, character text, and quote.
Minimal Mode 0 schema omits sex, position, supplement, text, quote, placement, and panels.
